description.value: Lodge 147 is a prefabricated, single-storey industrial work camp operated by Royal Camp Services Ltd at Mile 147 of the Alaska Highway, roughly 5 km north of Pink Mountain, BC. It is primarily designed as workforce housing, with professional culinary teams providing daily meals on site. Advance reservations are required, making it a planned stopover rather than a drop-in option for cyclists traversing this remote stretch of northern British Columbia.
